content:
Ryan S: Hey team — BigBank sent SIG v5.1, deadline EOD PST. They're asking for evidence for items Q1.3 (data encryption at rest), Q2.1 (subprocessors), Q4.5 (incident response). Can security help collate? If we don't have docs, we need redlines for their vendor portal.
Maria G: On it. I'll gather canonical evidence links: SOC2 report, encryption diagram, KMS rotate logs. Can someone from infra confirm KMS key ARN + rotation cadence?
Sam: KMS key is arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345. Rotation is annual; we rotate via Terraform -> apply in modules/kms. See https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/kms-rotation
Jordan K: For subprocessors — procurement maintains the list. I'll export CSV and drop to the drive. Also note we use Datadog and S3 (AWS) as subprocessors.
Maria G: For Q1.3 evidence I recommend: 1) SOC2 section page 12, 2) KMS ARN + rotation screenshot, 3) storage configuration snippet. I'll paste snippet for S3 SSE-KMS config.
Sam: ```
resource "aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration" "default" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.app.id
  rule { apply_server_side_encryption_by_default { sse_algorithm = "aws:kms" kms_master_key_id = aws_kms_key.main.arn } }
}
```
Maria G: For incident response Q4.5: link to runbook (https://confluence.redwood.ai/incidents/playbooks/sig-proc), and a recent postmortem for outage-2024-11-05. Also adding the escalation matrix screenshot.
Elaine T: I can produce a signed cover letter for the vendor portal. Do we want to redact IPs in the SOC2 before uploading? Legal prefers a redacted version.
Ryan S: Legal wants redacted. Maria, can you put a redacted SOC2 PDF in the shared folder and confirm which pages we submit?
Maria G: Will do. Uploading redacted SOC2 now to drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/teams/sales/BigBank/SIG/evidence (uploaded). File names: SOC2_redacted_2024.pdf, KMS_rotation_2024.png, subprocessors_list.csv
DevSecOps Bot: [automated] SOC2_redacted_2024.pdf scanned — no secrets detected. SHA256: abc123... :white_check_mark:
Jordan K: I've uploaded subprocessors_list.csv and added a column 'justification' per BigBank template.
Sam: Also adding config export for IAM policies used by the inference runtime: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-configs/infra/iam/inference-runtime-policy-2024.json
Maria G: Finalizing answers in the SIG spreadsheet. For Q1.3 answer: "We encrypt customer data at rest using AWS KMS (customer-managed key for Dedicated/Private, service-managed key for Hosted). See evidence: SOC2_redacted_2024.pdf (pg12), KMS_rotation_2024.png, S3 SSE-KMS snippet."
Ryan S: Amazing — can you paste that text into the vendor portal and close the ticket? I'll review before submit.
Maria G: Pasted and submitted into BigBank vendor portal. Screenshot of submission: https://drive.redwood.ai/teams/sales/BigBank/SIG/submission_screenshot.png
Elaine T: Legal approves submission. :thumbsup:
Ryan S: Thanks all. Marking the thread resolved. :tada:
